name: Distance below confirmed swing high
explain: Signed distance from close to the last confirmed swing high, measured in ATR units.
why: Inspect a delayed structural reference on completed OHLC bars; early values use the documented current-high fallback.
explanation: Positive values mean close is below the delayed reference; negative values mean it is above. This is bar-level measurement, not tick volatility or a directional trading recommendation. Before a confirmed pivot exists, the source block returns the current high.
